title: 第20章 百花楼第21章 完美刺杀
lines: 淮阴城，悦来客栈，二楼乙字房。
楚生打开窗户，看向斜对面的百花楼，门口一排浓装艳抹的女子正展示着胸器诱惑街上来往行人。
二楼的视野更好，累累硕果，格外诱人，楚生有些口干，自语道：“进内城已经有十天了，跟踪王麟这么久，总算摸出他进百花楼的规律了。”
“三天来一次，倒是挺有节奏，十几岁的年纪，果然血气旺盛！”
王麟出门，时时都有护卫跟随，这让楚生一直没有机会下手。
王家的侍卫，而且还是家主之子的侍卫，楚生可不敢小觑，只能一直跟踪寻找机会。
“不能再耽误下去了，多在内城待一天，就浪费一天赚取杀戮值的时间，自行修炼的速度还是太慢了。”
望着楼下的一对白桃，若隐若现，让人垂涎欲滴，楚生咽了咽口水，燥热道：“今天正好是王麟来喝花酒的日子，不能再等下去了。”
“百花楼这等龙潭虎穴，我非得探一探它的深浅！”
趁着天色还早，楚生将刀放在客栈，在腰侧插入一把匕首，然后换上一身花费二两银子买的长衫。
看着铜镜里的自己，一米七几的身高，矫健有力的身形，轮廓明晰的五官，看起来颇有一番富家公子的味道，楚生满意地点了点头，然后走出房门。
楚生从客栈门口走出，就闻到一阵甜蜜的香风，他寻着源头走去，见一个个汉子在门口驻足，流连忘返。
那女子窈窕的身姿，前凸后翘，在特制的束腰裙下勾勒出夺命的傲人曲线。
花枝招展的姑娘招揽着客人，犹如在跳舞一样，胸前的水蜜桃剧烈地晃动着，就像熟透的果实摇摇欲坠一般。
一个穿着青色武道袍的少年武者，原计划拿钱去买丹药，路过百花楼就走不动了，被几个丰满的姑娘簇拥着走了进去。
“小哥，来玩耍啊～”
“我百花楼的姑娘，琴棋书画样样精通，包您满意。”
还没等到楚生走近，就有三个年轻貌美的女子主动迎了上来，楚生眼前只剩下一片雪白和芬芳。
万花丛中过，楚生便发现自己已经身处百花楼大厅，方才的姑娘又回到门口招揽客人去了。
错落有致的雅座足有二十多桌，嫖客和姑娘们在大厅中寻欢作乐，宽衣解带；中央舞台上暴露女子打扮妖娆，舞姿曼妙；乐师于屏风后演奏丝竹乐器，音乐悠扬；身姿勾人的侍女举着美酒佳肴，笑吟吟地来回穿梭。
一个风韵犹存的老鸨摇曳着身段走到楚生身边，挺了挺诱人的硕果，满脸堆笑道：“公子好眼力！
今儿个是头一回来吧？我是百花楼的容妈妈，您先请坐下，老身给您沏盏上好的花茶润润喉。”
楚生自然明白老鸨的意思，掏出银子，傲然道：“不必啰嗦，给本公子找个雅致的座儿，这茶钱你收好。”
“好嘞！
公子爽快！
您且赏着大厅的曲儿，稍后姑娘们就来敬茶！”
老鸨接过银钱，殷勤道。
楚生躺在长椅上，一边喝着茶水，一边笑吟吟地欣赏着台上的舞女，又薄又短的花边裙摆下露出一双洁白修长的美腿，裙底的风光若隐若现，眼中的淫光让人一看就会认为楚生已经陶醉其中。
唯有在别人不注意的时候，楚生的眼角余光却是瞥向了门口，等待着王麟的到来。
不多时，老鸨带着五个羞涩可怜的年轻姑娘到楚生身前，喜笑颜开道：“公子，您看这几位姑娘，年轻貌美，吹拉弹唱样样在行，您可还满意？”
楚生扫了一眼，有高冷的、有可爱的、有温柔似水的，五个姑娘各有千秋，但统一的都是身材凹凸有致，皮肤洁白光滑，五官精致，心中暗叹老鸨不愧是妈妈级的人物，果然懂得拿捏人心。
原本只是想来打探消息的楚生，此刻也不由得认真起来，选了一个身着白色百花裙的姑娘，然后道：“容妈妈有心了，这位姑娘留下就行。”
content_en:
Huaiyin City, Yuelai Inn, room B on the second floor.
Chu Sheng opened the window and looked diagonally across the street from the Baihua Building. At the door, a row of women in colorful clothes were showing off their breasts to seduce passers-by on the street.
The view on the second floor was better, and the fruits were abundant, which was particularly attractive. Chu Sheng felt a little dry and said to himself: "It has been ten days since I entered the inner city. I have followed Wang Lin for so long, and I finally figured out the pattern of his entry into Baihua Tower."
"I come here every three days, it's quite rhythmic. I'm still a teenager, and I'm really full of energy!"
When Wang Lin went out, he was always followed by guards, which gave Chu Sheng no chance to make a move.
Chu Sheng did not dare to underestimate the bodyguards of the Wang family, and the bodyguards of the family master's son. He could only keep following and looking for opportunities.
"We can't delay any longer. If we stay in the inner city for another day, we will waste a day of earning kill points. The speed of self-cultivation is still too slow."
Looking at the pair of white peaches downstairs, looming and salivating, Chu Sheng swallowed his saliva and said hotly: "Today is the day when Wang Lin comes to drink flower wine, we can't wait any longer."
"Baihua Tower is like a dragon's pond and a tiger's den. I have to explore its depth!"
While it was still early, Chu Sheng placed the knife at the inn, inserted a dagger into his waist, and then put on a long gown that he bought for twenty taels of silver.
Looking at himself in the bronze mirror, with a height of more than 1.7 meters, a strong and strong figure, and clear-cut facial features, he looked quite like a rich man. Chu Sheng nodded with satisfaction and walked out of the room.
When Chu Sheng walked out of the door of the inn, he smelled a sweet fragrance. He looked for the source and saw men stopping at the door, lingering.
The woman's slender figure, with her front and back curved, outlined her life-threatening and proud curves under the specially made waist skirt.
The flowery girl is attracting guests as if she is dancing, and the peach on her chest is shaking violently, just like a ripe fruit teetering on the verge of falling.
A young warrior wearing a blue martial arts robe originally planned to use money to buy elixirs, but he couldn't walk when he passed by Baihua Tower. He was surrounded by several plump girls and walked in.
"Brother, come and play~"
"I, the girl from Baihualou, am proficient in music, chess, calligraphy and painting. I guarantee your satisfaction."
Before Chu Sheng could get closer, three young and beautiful women took the initiative to greet him. Chu Sheng's eyes were only filled with white snow and fragrance.
After passing through thousands of flowers, Chu Sheng found himself in the lobby of Baihua Tower. The girl just now returned to the door to solicit guests.
There are more than 20 tables in the well-proportioned seats. Prostitutes and girls are having fun in the hall, undressing and undressing; women are exposed on the central stage dressed voluptuously and dancing gracefully; musicians play silk and bamboo instruments behind the screen, and the music is melodious; seductive maids carry wine and delicacies, and shuttle back and forth with a smile.
An old madam with still charming charm walked up to Chu Sheng, swaying her figure, erecting her attractive breasts, and said with a smile on her face: "Young master, you have good eyesight!
Is this your first time back? I am Rong’s mother from Baihualou. Please sit down first and I will make you a cup of fine scented tea to soothe your throat. "
Chu Sheng naturally understood what the madam meant, took out the money, and said proudly: "No need to be verbose, find an elegant seat for me, and keep the tea money."
"Okay!
Young Master is so happy!
Just enjoy the music in the hall, and the girls will come to serve you tea later! "
The old bustard took the money and said politely.
Chu Sheng was lying on the bench, drinking tea and admiring the dancer on the stage with a smile. A pair of slender white legs were exposed under the thin and short lace skirt. The scenery under the skirt was looming. The lustful light in his eyes made people think that Chu Sheng was intoxicated.
Only when others were not paying attention, Chu Sheng glanced at the door from the corner of his eye, waiting for Wang Lin's arrival.
Not long after, the old madam brought five shy and pitiful young girls to Chu Sheng, and said with a smile: "Master, look at these girls, they are young and beautiful, and they are good at playing, playing and singing. Are you satisfied?"
Chu Sheng glanced at them. Some were cold, some were cute, and some were as gentle as water. Each of the five girls had their own merits, but they all had a curvy figure, white and smooth skin, and exquisite facial features. He secretly sighed in his heart that the madam was indeed a mother-level figure, and she really knew how to manipulate people's hearts.
Chu Sheng, who originally just wanted to inquire about the news, couldn't help but become serious at this moment. He chose a girl in a white floral skirt and said, "If Mom is interested, this girl can stay."
